patterns.what_worked: Reading the sim sources directly (wowsims master branch, fetched 2026-10-19) instead of trusting the audit's paraphrase: it confirmed the Execute drain, the Overpower/Execute stance requirements and the Devastate line, and it corrected the audit's Devastate wording (the rage > 60 line is the FURY APL, not the arms one). Reusing the live guide engine for the practice pick made the scenario and the live prompt structurally unable to disagree.
patterns.what_was_hard: The contract fixed ctx = { now, last_action, resources, cooldowns } with no run-scoped state, so the drills grade ONE decision each and the audit's run-level band tables were moved into pure helpers in warrior_guide.lua for the engine to aggregate. Lua 5.1's 200-local chunk limit also forced the practice helpers onto one table local.
patterns.skill_gap: Deciding where the audit's [DESIGN] band edges disagree with the sim's own rule (the Sunder stack band) needed a documented interpretation rather than a literal copy; the interpretation is written into the bench file so the operator can overrule it.
